reply.text:
Being the smaller one in the group is really common at twelve. Kids grow on very different schedules, and that has nothing to do with how hard you work or how strong you'll end up.

A program, or getting big, is one to talk through with a parent and your doctor first. They can tell you what's right for you at your age. I'm glad to help with the training side once they're on board.

Until then, sports, playing outside, pull-up bars at the park, and sleeping well are all great ways to build a strong base. Eating regular meals helps too. Check in with a parent, and we'll pick this up from there.
